newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $16 mln trade surplus in 2nd wk June.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $16 mln trade surplus in 2nd wk June.

text.p: Brazil posted a $16 million trade surplus in the second week of June, bringing the trade surplus in the month's first two weeks to $86 million, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
A ministry spokeswoman said exports totalled $1.149 billion and imports reached $1.133 billion in the second week.
She also said the average daily exports in June's second week were $229.8 million while average imports reached $226.6 million.
The spokeswoman said the exports in June's first two weeks, or first 10 working days, were $2.299 billion, for a daily average of $229.9 million.
Imports in the two-week period totalled $2.213 billion, for an average of $221.3 million a day.
Brazil posted a $271 million trade deficit in May, its lowest shortfall in 12 months thanks to seasonal hikes in agricultural exports.
